value: Official LAMMPS granular unit-test input, tagged unvetted
The official input is in the newer 29dd3fd source snapshot and explicitly carries the unvetted tag; previous results keep their original source pins.
LAMMPS SDS torque coefficients map to FunDEM length-scaled coefficients using D=2 R_eff, not R: k=ktw/D^2, c=gtw/D^2, mu=mut/D.
All positive-spin contact samples are checked against Mz=-mut Fn with instantaneous load; the constant-load reference is only the official analytic approximation.
The saved step-zero frame precedes initial force assembly. Only derived impulse quadrature reconstructs Fn0=kn(R-z0) and Mz0=-mut Fn0; raw data is unchanged.
The trajectory force is contact force; gravity is included separately in normal momentum balance.

Native elastic and damping history sharing differs generally from LAMMPS sum-then-clip. This saturated example validates the torque cap and spin integration, not all uncapped SDS stiffness/damping behavior.
Official acceptance is omega_z=8.8 rad/s at 30 ms within 1%; final 50 ms omega_z=8 is supplementary.
Normal restitution=1 and explicit cn=ct=cr=0; explicit torsional damping maps from the official nonzero gtw.
The official initial height is retained even though it produces approximately 13.18% undamped normal-load oscillation.
The harmonic normal-load/spin solution is an independent continuous-time diagnostic; the official target is not replaced.
Tangential and rolling modes are inactive under exactly axial spin; ordinary R-overlap friction force moment is zero.
All four linear stiffnesses are explicit; E/nu are inactive schema placeholders, not fitted values.
All 5001 configured native frames per run are retained at 10 us; CSV preserves every integration step.
Official epsilon = 1e-10 is same-code stored-state precision, not the cross-code criterion.
